sloka: सो ऽभिगम्य तु सौमित्रिमुवाच ऋषिसत्तमः ।रामं दर्शय मे शीघ्रं पुरा मे ऽर्थो ऽतिवर्तते ।। ७.१०५.२ ॥
transliteration: so 'bhigamya tu saumitrimuvāca ṛṣisattamaḥ ।rāmaṁ darśaya me śīghraṁ purā me 'rtho 'tivartate ।। 7.105.2 ॥

translations.english: Having approached Saumitri, the best of sages indeed said, "Show Rama to me quickly, before my purpose passes away."
